edge_cases_discovered: Pinnacle scraper writes captured_at to minute precision (2026-05-26T14:02), while FanDuel/Bovada use second precision (2026-05-26T12:24:41). Validator handles both formats.
Some snapshots ship with Z suffix (UTC marker). Parser strips Z and treats as naive local since the scraper and CLI run on the same host.
When line + odds match, the freshest matching snapshot wins among multiple candidates within the staleness window (so we always report the most recent age_sec).
Live data smoke confirmed real movement: Keldon REB OVER 3.5 @ Pinnacle moved +157 -> +160 between slate capture and bet attempt; validator caught it.
Existing test_place_bet.py suite required adding --force-stale to its fixture helper to avoid coupling with live line state. Validator semantics owned by test_line_validator.py.
